notes: Paper is on ultralight vector (dark photon) B-L dark matter; the constrained quantity is the U(1)_{B-L} gauge coupling g_BL, so VectorBL (NOT ScalarBaryon, overriding the hint). The main new results are PROJECTED sensitivities for optomechanical cavities (Fig. 5, f0=0.1/1/10 Hz), which are DM-density dependent (rho ~ GeV/cm^3). Separately, Appendix E recomputes an updated OBSERVED limit from the final MICROSCOPE results: g_BL <~ 7e-26 at low masses (mass-independent fifth-force bound, hence no DM density). I report this MICROSCOPE flat limit as a two-point horizontal line over the low-mass validity range (~1e-19 to ~1e-14 eV) since it is the clean text value matching the paper title. They also express it as |eps_BL| <~ 8.93e-19*(N/A).
